0.name: Card-centric active savers
0.one_liner: High card penetration, healthy balances, no loan — solvent, engaged spenders.
0.default_play: Premium card upgrade + careful first-loan offer; savings/invest.

decision.play: Premium card + first loan to solvent customers
decision.evidence: High card penetration + highest balances + no loan
decision.kpi: Interchange / premium upgrade; responsible first-loan take-up

1.name: New basic accounts
1.one_liner: Newer accounts with light product depth; still active — onboarding window is open.
1.default_play: First card / digital activation; watch early dormancy.

decision.evidence: Short tenure, low loan/card penetration, still recent activity

2.name: Loan-centric high-volume
2.one_liner: Credit relationship already established; high flows around loan servicing.
2.default_play: Card attach, PPI/protection, refinance / top-up retention.

decision.kpi: Card penetration among borrowers; retention at refinance

3.name: Long-tenure high-activity basic
3.one_liner: Loyal, high-activity, almost no loan/card. Trust exists; monetization does not.
3.default_play: Highest-value cross-sell: pre-approved card / personal loan from txn history.

decision.evidence: Highest activity + long tenure + ~0 credit products
decision.guardrail: Use txn history for pre-approve; consent + eligibility

4.name: Financially stressed / overdraft risk
4.one_liner: Negative mean balance; withdrawals dominate credits.
4.default_play: Service + risk review, budgeting tools — not investment pitches.

decision.guardrail: Do NOT pitch investments; limit new unsecured credit

5.name: Dormant long-term accounts
5.one_liner: Long recency gap — relationship effectively elsewhere.
5.default_play: Win-back then close; do not push sales hard.

decision.kpi: Reactivation rate; dormant balance recovered / closed
decision.guardrail: Not a churn model — strategy from dormancy proxy only
